nodes.description: Mapping(address => Bet) storing each player's bet value and the block height at which the bet was placed; keyed by msg.sender.
Empty public constructor of HashBet; performs no initialization.
Payable fallback function that silently accepts ether without updating any accounting state.
Payable public function that requires no existing open bet (height == 0) and msg.value > 10000, then records msg.value and block.number for msg.sender in the bets mapping.
Public function that computes a pseudo-random result from block.blockhash values, resets the caller's bet height to 0 and transfers the entire contract balance to the winner.
Caller-controlled address used as the key into the bets mapping and as the recipient of the payout transfer.
msg.sender.transfer(address(this).balance) inside resolveBet: sends the whole contract balance to an untrusted external address after state reset, a classic reentrancy / force-feed payout surface.
keccak256(block.blockhash(bet.height), block.blockhash(bet.height+3)) used as an on-chain randomness source that is predictable and miner-influenceable.
Storage reference to bets[msg.sender] in makeBet; fields value and height are assigned from msg.value and block.number.
Reference to bets[msg.sender] in resolveBet, holding the value and height of the caller's bet.
block.number - bet.height in resolveBet; required to be greater than 3 and less than 255.
bytes32 = block.blockhash(bet.height), the first blockhash-derived entropy value in resolveBet.
bytes32 = block.blockhash(bet.height + 3), the second blockhash-derived entropy value in resolveBet.
uint256 = keccak256(h1, h2) in resolveBet; the derived random value fed into the modulo computation.
Constant divisor approximating 2^256/1000 used to scale hashVal into a 0..999 range in resolveBet.
uint16 = (hashVal / FACTOR) % 1000; values <= 495 trigger the payout transfer in resolveBet.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mapping key when reading and writing bets[msg.sender] inside makeBet.
msg.sender selects the bet record read in resolveBet via bets[msg.sender].
The untrusted msg.sender address is the recipient of the full contract balance transfer, exposing the payout to attacker-controlled receivers.
makeBet authorization is derived solely from msg.sender (bets[msg.sender].height == 0), so the caller identity fully gates bet creation.
makeBet writes msg.value and block.number into the bets mapping entry for the caller.
resolveBet reads bet.height and bet.value from the bets mapping and resets bet.height to 0.
resolveBet can invoke the external value transfer to msg.sender, the classic reentrancy entry point.
When result <= 495 resolveBet executes the balance transfer, making the payout branch attacker-reachable.
resolveBet derives its outcome from block.blockhash values, a predictable randomness source manipulable by miners/validators.
h1 is produced directly from block.blockhash(bet.height), inheriting the weak randomness weakness.
h2 is produced directly from block.blockhash(bet.height + 3), inheriting the weak randomness weakness.
makeBet assigns msg.value and block.number to the newBet storage reference.
resolveBet loads the caller's stored bet into the local bet reference.
resolveBet computes dist from block.number minus bet.height and range-checks it.
h1 is hashed together with h2 to produce hashVal in resolveBet.
h2 is hashed together with h1 to produce hashVal in resolveBet.
resolveBet derives hashVal through keccak256 of the blockhash seeds.
resolveBet defines the FACTOR scaling constant used to reduce hashVal.
resolveBet computes the uint16 result from hashVal / FACTOR modulo 1000.
hashVal flows into the modulo computation that yields result.

normalization_plan.reason: newBet is a function-local storage reference used only inside makeBet to store the caller's bet value and height; it carries no independent semantics.
bet is a function-local reference to bets[msg.sender] used only inside resolveBet for reading and clearing the caller's bet.
dist is a temporary computed distance used solely for the range require inside resolveBet.
h1 is directly produced by the block.blockhash randomness operation and has no meaning outside that unsafe entropy source.
h2 is directly produced by the block.blockhash randomness operation and has no meaning outside that unsafe entropy source.
hashVal is an intermediate hashed value consumed only by resolveBet's outcome computation.
FACTOR is a fixed scaling constant local to resolveBet and not observable elsewhere.
result is the branch condition that directly controls execution of the balance transfer to msg.sender in resolveBet.
